content.text: In Zimbabwe, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-digital-product-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-solutions-west-africa-working-2|digital]] creators face a critical [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-2|The Full]] gap: payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible, leaving no reliable way to sell digital products online. This isn’t a policy issue—it’s a systemic exclusion from global commerce tools. The solution requires sovereign infrastructure, not workarounds. Supabase, paired with Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, delivers a self-owned, fully operational digital store stack. This guide walks you through deploying Supabase as your order database, integrating crypto payments, and automating product delivery—all without relying on third-party platforms. By the end, you’ll own a commerce stack that operates on your terms, not Stripe’s.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms fail creators in two ways: they restrict access or confiscate control. Stripe’s absence in Zimbabwe isn’t an oversight—it’s a deliberate exclusion. Supabase, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments solve this by shifting ownership to you. Supabase acts as your order database, storing every transaction on infrastructure you control. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, ensuring instant product delivery without platform delays. NOWPayments processes crypto payments directly to your wallet, bypassing intermediaries. This stack isn’t a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure. You deploy it once, own it forever, and operate without subscriptions or platform fees. It’s built for creators who choose sovereignty over dependency.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, ensure you have three components: a Supabase account (free tier suffices), a Cloudflare account for Workers and Pages, and a NOWPayments API key. Create a Supabase project and initialize a table for orders—columns should include buyer email, product ID, transaction hash, and status. Set up Cloudflare Workers to handle webhook logic, triggering product delivery when NOWPayments confirms payment. For file storage, use Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Test your workflow locally using mock data to ensure Supabase writes, Workers execute, and files deliver correctly. This preparation ensures seamless deployment and minimizes live errors.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring NOWPayments to send webhooks to your Cloudflare Worker. In the Worker script, write logic to verify the payment hash, update the Supabase order status, and generate a secure download link. Use Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive to store product files, and embed the link in an automated email sent via Cloudflare Workers. Ensure the Worker validates the buyer’s email against the Supabase order record to prevent unauthorized access. Test the pipeline with a small transaction on the BSC network (fees under $0.10) to confirm Supabase updates, the email delivers, and the file downloads. This pipeline automates the entire transaction flow without manual intervention.
Supabase stores your orders—no platform has access.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your stack by connecting your custom domain to Cloudflare Pages and publishing your Worker. Point your store’s checkout button to the NOWPayments invoice generator, ensuring the webhook URL points to your Worker. Promote your product and monitor the Supabase dashboard for incoming orders. When the first transaction confirms, the Worker should update the order status, send the download email, and log the transaction hash in Supabase. Verify the buyer receives the product and the payment hits your wallet. This live transaction proves your infrastructure operates independently of platforms like Stripe or PayPal.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With the stack live, scale by adding products to your Supabase database and updating the Worker logic to handle new product IDs. Use Cloudflare’s edge network to serve download links globally, reducing latency for international buyers. Monitor Supabase for order volume and upgrade to a paid tier if needed. For higher transaction volumes, integrate additional payment networks via NOWPayments (Solana, TRON) to keep fees under $0.10. Document your deployment process to replicate the stack for new stores or clients. This infrastructure scales with your business, not against it.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Supabase serves as the order database, storing transaction details, buyer information, and product IDs. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, processing NOWPayments webhooks, updating order statuses, and triggering product delivery. NOWPayments processes crypto payments, sending instant confirmations to the Worker. Together, they create a self-owned commerce stack that operates without Stripe or PayPal. Cloudflare Workers automate delivery the moment payment confirms.

If you’re ready to deploy this infrastructure without building it from scratch, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) delivers a fully configured Supabase database, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments integration in 48 hours. It includes five products loaded, email delivery configured, and 30-day support. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to order.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a Supabase project and initialize an orders table with columns for buyer email, product ID, transaction hash, and status. 2. Set up a Cloudflare Worker to handle NOWPayments webhooks, updating Supabase and generating download links. 3. Configure NOWPayments to send webhooks to your Worker, using BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees. 4. Test the pipeline locally with mock data to ensure Supabase writes, Workers execute, and files deliver. 5. Deploy the stack via Cloudflare Pages, connect your domain, and point your checkout to NOWPayments. 6. Monitor Supabase for live orders and verify the first transaction end-to-end.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use Supabase on the free tier?
Yes, Supabase’s free tier suffices for most digital stores. Upgrade only if order volume exceeds limits.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees: BSC, Solana, TRON.
How do I secure product files?
Store files in Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Generate signed URLs with expiration dates to prevent unauthorized access.
Can I integrate multiple payment networks?
Yes, NOWPayments allows integrating multiple networks. Add Solana or TRON for redundancy and lower fees.
What happens if a payment fails?
The Worker logs the failure in Supabase and does not trigger product delivery. Retest the transaction or refund the buyer.
NOWPayments processes crypto without buyer accounts or KYC.
